title: Form Smallest Number From Two Digit Arrays
summary: The inputs nums1 and nums2 each contain nonrepeating decimal digits.
statement: The inputs nums1 and nums2 each contain nonrepeating decimal digits. Return the numerically smallest integer whose digits include at least one member of nums1 and at least one member of nums2; a shared digit can satisfy both requirements.
constraints: Each input contains distinct digits from one through nine.
Form the smallest positive integer containing a digit from each input; one shared digit may satisfy both.
hints: Check whether the two sets share a digit.
If so, the smallest shared digit is a one-digit answer and beats every two-digit answer.
Otherwise take the minimum digit from each set and try both two-digit orders.
No larger chosen digit can improve either place, so the smaller ordering of the two minima is globally optimal.
editorial: No larger chosen digit can improve either place, so the smaller ordering of the two minima is globally optimal.

tests.explanation: There is no shared digit, and arranging the smallest choices as 15 is optimal.
The shared digit three forms the one-digit answer three.
